Four online transactions occurred on card SC-03020-K954 within a 48-hour window [EV-82f99513], with the flagged transaction originating from a device marked 'New' for the account (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) [EV-7a71e869] and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-1541bf16]. The device profile appears in one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-5cf862ce], and the customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4325) [EV-ed53b800]. The customer states they did not make the purchases and still possesses the card [EV-1d3d17c1]. Six prior closed cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-2e1264ab].

The real-time model scored the initial transaction 4012186 at 0.81, prompting review [EV-0bf6f99b]. Within 48 hours, four online transactions were processed on card SC-03020-K954 [EV-82f99513], deviating from the card's historical average of $163.58 across four prior transactions [EV-590c8c79]. The device fingerprint (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) was flagged as new to the account and is associated with one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-7a71e869, EV-5cf862ce]. The connection used an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-1541bf16]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and confirms physical possession of the card [EV-1d3d17c1]. The customer also has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4325) [EV-ed53b800]. The pattern matches six prior closed investigations for card_not_present_new_device [EV-2e1264ab]. Total exposure across transactions 4012186, 4012187, 4012188, and 4012189 is $654.31. The case was closed with a fraud verdict.
